description.value:
A viscera graft that doesn't just metabolize — it gestates. Once per week, over a night's rest, incubate and lay a single Tiny venomous or acidic creature (roughly your level −4) that serves you for 24 hours before dissolving.

Rider: It wants to keep something alive in there even when you don't ask it to. Miss a week without laying, and the GM rolls what it grows instead.

cinderfall.incomplete: The whole ability spawns a controlled Tiny creature once per week -- granting a functioning minion/companion actor is outside system.rules entirely (no Familiar/Eidolon-style companion-grant rule element exists for a plain equipment item); GM-run as narrated.
